prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Brand new Arcanoclisma TCG scene "Gladiador da Arena", RARE ally. Polished fantasy narrative illustration matching approved second reference: crisp selective contours, smooth painted broad surfaces, controlled shadows and material texture, integrated lighting and contact shadows. No gritty canvas grain, overly expressive scratched scenery, excessive HDR/anime gloss, foggy wash or blooms. Actual NEW single painted scene; not a transparent RPG cutout pasted onto an environment. Opaque full background to all edges, portrait 63:88 requested1260x1760. No lettering, card frame, UI, stats or watermarks. Leave key faces/action above lower third for overlay. Rare finish: subtle SILVER and VIOLET glints, no rainbow or gold foil wash.
Reference1 IDENTITY ONLY: very large muscular tan adult man with unruly short dark hair and thick dark beard, broad scarred face, bare chest with crossed leather harness, oversized dark golden bronze left shoulder guard, bronze bracers and knee guards, creamwrapped lowerlegs, bronze strapped sandals, torn red/cream cloth skirt with mutedblue panel. Preserve design but completely change posture. Reference2 painterly finish ONLY; no meadow, woman, dragon, mountains or daylight borrowed.
NIGHT in a fantasy circular arena floating over a smooth dark mercury sea under two gently overlapping crescent-like cloud bands and a full moon. Ruined arena rail frames foreground, warm terracotta and dark bronze architectural accents counter cool silver-violet moonlight. View through an empty arch, gently tilted camera. Gladiator in middle right crouches on ONE knee in SIDE PROFILE, massive torso upright, turning his chin upward with teeth clenched and a fierce watchful stare, not a frontal roar. Both forearms crossed ABOVE and before his face, preparing to brace an incoming impact; huge hands closed, normal two arms anatomically clear. A smaller ally shelters behind his shoulder deeper in scene. A few subtle silvery vapor threads bead and crystallize around the arena railing before any blow arrives, integrated world magic, no giant blast or comet. Arena crowd tiny distant silhouettes, floating towers on horizon and the moon reflected in mercury explain his environment. Warm gentle torch niches, moonlight keeps face and anatomy readable. Show the tense instant BEFORE action with no duplicated attacking opponent in foreground. Deep blue-grey, mercury silver, muted violet and burnt red. Smooth broad stone planes and painted clouds, no noisy scratched terrain. Crisp face and armor focal detail, rich shadow colors, no washed out haze or resplendent gold. All freshly painted as one coherent scene.
avaliacaoVisual: Gladiador identificado por corpo, rosto e armadura, com defesa de braços cruzados distinta da base. Arena noturna com mercúrio e torres flutuantes, contorno nítido; prata/violeta localizados e tochas quentes.
